page.overview:
Who is Demira Eriff?

Demira Eriff is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Demira Eriff}}

Demira is a gracefully beautiful Domani with coppery skin. She wears clothing in the fashion of her native Arad Doman, although she often contemplates switching to less provocative dresses. as she does not like the unwanted attention. However, she never got around to changing her dresses as she was preoccupied with other matters.

Demira is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

She is the third weakest among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Berenicia Morsad and Valinde Nathenos being weaker and Kairen Stang being her equal. She is, however, only slightly weaker than Merana Ambrey and several others.
